title: Proposition 7.8: fully faithful base change on presentable module categories
statement_scope: Let a pullback diagram of connective E2-rings A -> A0, A1 -> A01 be given, and suppose f:A0 -> A01 and g:A1 -> A01 induce surjections π0A0 -> π0A01 <- π0A1. Then the induced functor F: LMod_{LMod_A}(Pr^L_{t±}) -> LMod_{LMod_A0}(Pr^L_{t±}) ×_{LMod_{LMod_A01}(Pr^L_{t±})} LMod_{LMod_A1}(Pr^L_{t±}) is fully faithful. Whole proposition, not split.
